visuals.heading: Compare the Practical Paths

rows: Failed one or two subjects (compartment)
In CBSE's 2026 scheme, as reported by All India Radio, a student with a compartment result can sit the second exam in the compartment category to clear the subject not passed.
Ask your school for the second-exam form date and the subjects you are eligible to re-sit.
Failed three or more subjects (essential repeat)

All India Radio reported CBSE saying that students who miss three or more subjects in the first exam are not eligible for the second exam and are placed in Essential Repeat. The report does not say whether 'miss' means failing or being absent, so ask your school.
Repeat Class 10, take a private route where the board allows it, or move to NIOS Secondary.
Passed theory but missed internal or practical marks
CBSE bye-law 40.1, as read by the Delhi High Court, asks for 33 percent in theory and in practical or internal assessment separately. Check whether that applies to the subject you failed.
Ask the school which component you failed and whether the second exam covers it.
State board or ICSE result
Each board has its own supplementary rules, names and dates. The CBSE details above do not transfer.
Read your own board's circular and ask the school office for the form deadline.
Who can join Secondary
A learner needs Class VIII passed and proof of age 14, according to the NIOS regional centre FAQ.
Credit for subjects you passed
Learners from other boards can transfer up to two subjects passed in the last five years, if those subjects are in the NIOS scheme. Ask at admission, with the original marksheet.
Pass rule
Five subjects, with 33 percent in each external exam and 33 percent in aggregate, as the FAQ states.
Exam timing
On-demand exams run monthly after the first public exam, so you choose when to sit a subject once you are ready.
Cost anchor
The FAQ lists Rs 250 per theory subject and Rs 100 per practical for an on-demand exam. Check the current table before you pay.
Recognition

NIOS says its certificates carry equal recognition with other boards, and the Association of Indian Universities has granted equivalence for higher studies. Check any specific school, college or exam you want.

blocks.heading: What a Failed Class 10 Allows
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: ITI and polytechnic: what a failed Class 10 allows

rows: ITI trades
The DGT page for NSTI Indore lists Class 10 for most trades, Class 8 for Dress Making, a minimum age of 14 and no upper age limit.
Most trades run one year. NCVT awards the National Trade Certificate after the exam.
Polytechnic diploma
Nagaland's rules ask for Class 10 passed, with Maths and Science for the engineering diploma. A failed Class 10 therefore blocks it until the pass is cleared.
A three-year diploma. Lateral entry to the second year of a degree exists, with Nagaland capping it at 10 percent of intake.
Tamil Nadu failed-student admission
A 2023 news report said students who fail Class 10 can join ITI or polytechnic courses on a Class 8 certificate in that state.
A ladder of ITI, then second-year diploma, then second-year degree, according to the same report. It is state specific.
